scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && node scripts/require-typescript-7.mjs && tsc -b && pnpm --filter ./packages/vscode build:bundle
scripts.verify: pnpm quality && pnpm test && pnpm coverage && pnpm build && pnpm performance:gate
scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/e2e-postgres generate:snapshot && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/e2e-mysql generate:snapshot && pnpm --filter './packages/**' --if-present test && pnpm test:contracts
scripts.test:soundness: poku packages/postgres/test/soundness.test.ts packages/mysql/test/soundness.test.ts packages/compiler/test/soundness.test.ts packages/cli/test/soundness.test.ts packages/ts-bridge/test/soundness.test.ts packages/language-server/test/soundness.test.ts --reporter=compact --enforce
scripts.release:stable: pnpm release:assert stable && node scripts/publish-prerelease.mjs stable
scripts.release:check: pnpm verify && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/e2e-packed e2e && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high
scripts.coverage: pnpm --filter @typed-sql/core coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/ast coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/schema coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/config coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/compiler coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/postgres coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/mysql coverage
